title: Innokin Zenith Minimal Vape Tank
description: The Innokin EZ Tube Zenith Minimal Tank is a stunning testament to meticulous vaping design. This 2ml tank is not just a standard vape kit component; it's a gateway to a rich and versatile vaping experience. Compatible with the entire range of Innokin’s Z-Coils , it caters to a variety of vaping styles, from flavour-focused MTL (mouth-to-lung) to cloud-chasing DTL (direct-to-lung.) Refilling is a breeze thanks to the new 1/4 turn locking top cap. This feature ensures fast and secure refilling, so you can top up your e-liquid without any hassle. When it's time to change coils, the easy plug-pull mechanism simplifies the process, making it accessible even for beginners. The tank's smooth and precise bottom airflow control allows you to dial in your ideal draw, whether you prefer a tight, restricted inhale or a more open, airy one. It’s designed for hassle-free cleaning and maintenance, ensuring that keeping your tank in top condition is as straightforward as using it. Additionally, the tank is equipped with a 510 connector , making it a versatile option for various mods. The package includes both MTL and DTL drip tips, giving you the flexibility to switch your vaping style as you wish. Whether you’re a fan of intense flavour or impressive cloud production, the Innokin EZ Tube Zenith Minimal Tank is your reliable partner for a satisfying vape experience. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
